_comment: Copy to config/job_sources.json. Used by scripts/scrape.py to pull postings from public ATS job boards. No API key needed - these are the same public endpoints the company career pages use.
_title_keywords_note: A posting is kept only if its title contains one of these (case-insensitive). Keep them specific - a bare word like 'manager' matches hundreds of unrelated roles.
_location_keywords_note: A posting is kept only if its location contains one of these (e.g. 'remote', 'bangalore', 'london'). Empty list [] = accept every location. Set this once you know where you want to work.
_boards_note: Find a company's token from its careers URL: boards.greenhouse.io/TOKEN, jobs.lever.co/TOKEN, jobs.ashbyhq.com/TOKEN. Only companies that use Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby work here - many firms run their own ATS and are not reachable this way; paste those JDs to the agent directly.
